en:
If you were to roll the shot
in there, it would reach the library.

I see... That air duct connects the classroom
to the library.

So, the shot is rolled into
the vent, passes through the duct...

...and comes out of the <CLT=cltSTRONG>air vent above the
library bookcase<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

But how could she have hit Rantaro
from all the way over there!?

The vent was way too far from
Rantaro's body!
So it was just a coincidence?
What kind of coincidence is that!?

<CLT=cltMIND>No, I already know
the answer to that as well...

<CLT=cltMIND>It was no coincidence. The culprit
set it up that way intentionally.

<CLT=cltMIND>If I'm remembering correctly,
there was something off about her then...

<CLT=cltMIND>Damn it, how
could I not realize it...?

<CLT=cltMIND>...It's too late
to regret the past.

<CLT=cltMIND>I said I wouldn't back down.
I made a promise!
